section_path: Backwards incompatible changes in 5.0 > Using ``create_defaults__exact`` may now be required with ``QuerySet.update_or_create()``
raw_text:
:meth:`.QuerySet.update_or_create` now supports the parameter
``create_defaults``. As a consequence, any models that have a field named
``create_defaults`` that are used with an ``update_or_create()`` should specify
the field in the lookup with ``create_defaults__exact``.

section_path: What's new in Django 6.0 > Template Partials
raw_text:
The :ref:`Django Template Language <template-language-intro>` now supports
:ref:`template partials <template-partials>`, making it easier to encapsulate
and reuse small named fragments within a template file. The new tags
:ttag:`{% partialdef %} <partialdef>` and :ttag:`{% partial %} <partial>`
define a partial and render it, respectively.
